defects.summary: Front likeness has large proportion deltas and profile candidate detection fails.
defects.likelyCause: MPFB blockout is not conformed MetaHuman identity topology and uses prototype eyes.
defects.recommendedModification: Run MetaHuman Identity solve, then tune face aspect, mouth and nose while preserving canonical profiles.

defects.summary: Face is too wide/short, mouth too narrow and profile skull/jaw remain incorrect.
defects.likelyCause: Low-resolution parametric blockout and absent high-resolution identity sculpt.
defects.recommendedModification: Conform to MetaHuman topology and author reversible high-resolution face corrections under fixed cameras.

defects.summary: Torso is proportionally too long although shoulder width is close.
defects.likelyCause: Current MPFB body preset does not match canonical torso-to-leg balance.
defects.recommendedModification: Choose a shorter MetaHuman torso without globally lengthening legs; validate walk and sit.

defects.summary: Only a 2K diffuse skin source exists.
defects.likelyCause: No production scan or authored multi-channel surface set has been created.
defects.recommendedModification: Author and bind the required 4K skin channels and facial-zone masks.

defects.summary: Prototype eyes lack physical tear line, wetness and MetaHuman eyelid-contact evidence.
defects.likelyCause: G1 semantic eye assembly was designed as blockout, not close-up production anatomy.
defects.recommendedModification: Use MetaHuman eye topology/materials and validate all six eye parts and blink contact.

defects.summary: Dense generic Blender groom lacks production styling, Unreal binding and fallback LOD.
defects.likelyCause: Hair Editor template cannot encode the canonical spatial density and clump design.
defects.recommendedModification: Author a production Groom with semantic groups, MetaHuman binding and cards/mesh fallback.

defects.summary: Production skin, eye and clothing material bindings do not exist.
defects.likelyCause: Current assets are reconstruction blockouts with diffuse/procedural materials.
defects.recommendedModification: Create Unreal material instances and checksummed PBR channel bindings.

defects.summary: No real MetaHuman DNA/RigLogic or Control Rig candidate exists.
defects.likelyCause: UE 5.6 MetaHuman Identity solve has not run.
defects.recommendedModification: Complete Identity solve and verify face/body Control Rig plus DNA/RigLogic in Editor.

defects.summary: No frame-level lip, eyelid, cheek or temporal deformation samples exist.
defects.likelyCause: A production facial rig and Editor capture are absent.
defects.recommendedModification: Emit all 495 diagnostics from the fixed 45-frame sequence and review matching renders.

defects.summary: Walk, sit, shoulder and extreme-pose body deformation is unverified.
defects.likelyCause: MetaHuman body selection, skinning and Editor runtime tests are pending.
defects.recommendedModification: Run fixed body/deformation cases and accept only zero clipping and bounded volume loss.

defects.summary: Blockout capture exposure passes, but production skin under multiple lighting conditions is absent.
defects.recommendedModification: Render neutral, flat inspection and adverse-light Go close-ups after surface binding.

defects.summary: Current close-up remains a blockout with non-production face, eyes, skin and hair.
defects.likelyCause: All hero-scale surface and Groom stages are pending.
defects.recommendedModification: Complete MetaHuman conform, production surfaces and Groom before close-up scoring.

defects.summary: No production Hero has run in Unreal or on Looking Glass Go.
defects.likelyCause: UE/MetaHuman toolchain and final assets are unavailable.
defects.recommendedModification: Run Editor and device QA, record frame time, memory, LOD and 66-view quilt evidence.
